user.title: SolaX Cloud Configuration
user.description: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret created in the SolaX Developer Platform. The Client Secret is displayed as a password field and is stored in this Home Assistant configuration entry.

data_description.client_id: Generated when you create an application in the SolaX Developer Platform
data_description.client_secret: Keep this value private; it is used to obtain an API access token
data_description.api_region: Choose the API region shown under My Account in the SolaX Developer Portal
data_description.inverter_sn: Serial number found on your inverter or in SolaXCloud app

error.invalid_auth: SolaX Cloud rejected the Client ID or Client Secret
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to SolaX Cloud

abort.already_configured: SolaX Cloud integration is already configured
